# On the FIRST mention in each document the target form is rendered as
#     Okrožno sodišče v Ljubljani (District Court in Ljubljana)
# and every later mention in that same document is the target form alone.
# The translator's rule: easier to delete something once than to hunt for a
# place where it is missing.
# Scoped per document, not per run. The same sentence may be the first
# mention in one file and the fortieth in another, which is why this is a
# deterministic pass over the translated text rather than an instruction to
# the model -- the memory keys on source text, so a bracketed translation
# cached from one document would surface wrongly in the next.
# Matching is on the target form the model actually produced. If the model
# renders an institution differently from the entry here, no bracket is
# added: a missing bracket is a visible omission the reviewer can fix, a
# wrong one is a defect that reads as correct.
# Add rows as a matter requires. Courts are per-city, so only the ones in
# use are listed; national bodies are fixed and seeded here.
